analysis.headline: Shares Your Data Broadly
analysis.quote: Depending on where you live, and your privacy settings, we share data for advertising and related purposes, including showing you ads about Pinterest on third-party services, enabling partners to show you ads both on and off Pinterest, and helping advertisers understand how ads on Pinterest perform.

analysis.headline: Sells Your Info for Ads
analysis.quote: Some of these activities may be considered “targeted advertising” “sharing” or “selling” as those terms are defined under certain state privacy laws in the US. You can opt out of Pinterest using and disclosing your information for these purposes.

analysis.headline: Trains AI on Your Content
analysis.quote: Improve the products and services of our family of companies and offer new features. For example, using information to train, develop and improve our technology such as our machine learning models, regardless of when Pins were posted.

analysis.headline: Infers Personal Details
analysis.quote: We may also infer other information, such as your education or professional experience.

analysis.headline: Infers Your Location
analysis.quote: We use your IP address to infer your approximate location, even if you don't choose to share your precise location, and photos you share may include information about the location where they were taken.

analysis.headline: Shares with Law Enforcement
analysis.quote: We may get requests for account information from law enforcement authorities like the police or courts, or from researchers to study activity on Pinterest.

analysis.headline: Facial Age Estimation
analysis.quote: Conduct age verification, as appropriate. This may include facial age estimation and matching your face against a government ID.

analysis.headline: Your Data Stored Internationally
analysis.quote: By using our products or services, you authorize us to transfer and store your information outside your home country, including in the United States, for the purposes described in this policy.

analysis.headline: Retains Data for Legal Claims
analysis.quote: We keep your information only so long as necessary for the purposes identified in this Privacy Policy, which include providing our Service, or for other legitimate purposes, such as complying with legal obligations, enforcing and preventing violations of our Terms, to fight spam, or protecting or defending our rights, property and users.
